name: code402
description: Autonomous non-custodial x402 clearinghouse (24 core checks + 7 revenue modules), XDR-1 cryptographic receipt verification, ISO 20022 / IBAN / LEI deterministic validation, and executable x402 conformance suite.

interface.shortDescription: x402 conformance, XDR-1 receipts & ISO 20022 validation
interface.longDescription: Equips coding agents with x402 EIP-3009 payment execution, offline and online XDR-1 cryptographic receipt verification, 19-check protocol conformance auditing, and 24 core deterministic checks + 7 revenue modules via the Code402 MCP rail.
capabilities: ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 IBAN & ISO 17442 LEI validation
defaultPrompt: Audit an x402 endpoint for protocol conformance, 402 challenge shape, and XDR-1 receipt verification.
Deterministically validate an IBAN, LEI, BIC/SWIFT, or VAT identifier via the Code402 MCP server.
Verify an XDR-1 cryptographic settlement receipt offline and via hcrb.in/v1/receipt/verify.
